stem: Which reason BEST explains why many Swedish people settled in the American Midwest?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: They wanted to work in steel mills.

options.label: G
options.text: They wanted to participate in the abolitionist movement.

options.label: H
options.text: They wanted to settle in large cities.

options.label: J
options.text: They wanted to find fertile farmland.

visual_elements: In accordance with our promise on our departure from Sweden we are sending you a few lines to tell you how and where we are situated at present. . . . We decided to settle in Iowa. . . . It has an abundance of water power, contains metals, marble, and several other natural resources, and only a very small part of this extensive territory is settled. . . . If only half of the work expended on the soil in the fatherland were utilized here, the yield would reach the wildest imagination. . . .  —Peter Cassel, letter to his father in Sweden, February 9, 1846
